Photorealistic product photograph of ONLY a selected tram instrument / switch PANEL, detached from its surrounding driver cab. A flat rectangular fitted metal plate viewed perfectly straight-on, orthographic frontal view like the SECOND framing-reference image. The entire image is occupied by the panel and its narrow frame. No desk, no apron, no seat, no window, no perspective room, no extra bottom row, no empty lower half. Use the FIRST reference photo ONLY to derive authentic switch hardware, materials, colours and layout style of this tram family. Do not copy the photo, watermark, people or outside view. Real satin industrial paint, fine wear, real photographed fittings and hardware, sharp reflections and physical shadows, strictly photo realism, absolutely no drawn vector / CSS-looking buttons. Frame must have four recessed metal corner screws, each fully visible on the plate. A selection of eight switches is used for simulation; leave small clear label spaces above switches, but generate no captions/words/logos. Additional small original instruments or spare switches may be present, but main controls must be large and clearly separated with enough room for an icon on the cap. Buttons must be shown straight from front with only slight visible physical protrusion of their caps. Landscape 3:2. No blank mounting areas; the real hardware itself will be animated in the application.
